parameters.name: Z1_Temp
parameters.physical_meaning: Pre-heat zone temperature, governs film entering temperature for stretch zone

parameters.name: Z2_Temp
parameters.physical_meaning: Mid-stretch zone temperature, influences MD stretch uniformity

parameters.name: Z3_Temp
parameters.physical_meaning: Final stretch zone temperature - Arrhenius-governed crystallization rate, strongest influence on haze and surface defects

parameters.name: Extruder_Speed
parameters.physical_meaning: Extruder screw speed, governs melt throughput and residence time

parameters.name: Melt_Pressure
parameters.physical_meaning: Melt pressure at die, coupled with Extruder_Speed via pump curve

parameters.name: Defect_Density
parameters.physical_meaning: Surface defect count per square meter

parameters.name: product
parameters.physical_meaning: Product code - two grades run on this line

equipment.name: Extruder
equipment.function: Melts and pumps polymer through die

equipment.name: Stretch_Oven
equipment.function: Multi-zone stretching oven with temperature control per zone

physical_principles.direction: T↑ → k↑ → crystallization rate increases → haze and surface defects increase

known_failure_modes.mechanism: Z3 temperature elevation increases PET crystallization rate exponentially (Arrhenius), causing higher haze and surface defect density
